RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel Agent must be installed
RemediationStrings.Description: Sync the device in Company Portal or contact desktop support.

RemediationStrings.Title: 必须安装 Sentinel Agent
RemediationStrings.Description: 打开公司门户同步设备，或联系桌面支持。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel file integrity check failed
RemediationStrings.Description: Sync the device to restore the verified runtime.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 文件完整性异常
RemediationStrings.Description: 设备将进入修复流程；请勿继续运行未经验证的本地副本。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel periodic scan is not running
RemediationStrings.Description: Sync the device in Company Portal to restore the scheduled task.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 周期扫描未启用
RemediationStrings.Description: 打开公司门户同步设备，恢复企业计划任务。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel secure reporting is not configured
RemediationStrings.Description: Sync the protected reporting configuration from Intune or contact security operations.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 安全上报尚未配置
RemediationStrings.Description: 从 Intune 同步受保护上报配置，或联系安全运营团队。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel has not reported successfully in 24 hours
RemediationStrings.Description: Check network access to the Collector, device time, credentials, and Intune synchronization.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 已超过 24 小时未成功上报
RemediationStrings.Description: 检查 Collector 网络连通性、设备时间、凭据和 Intune 同步状态。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel security policy must be updated
RemediationStrings.Description: Keep the device online and sync Intune.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 安全策略需要更新
RemediationStrings.Description: 保持设备联网并等待 Intune 修复任务同步最新策略。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel report contract validation failed
RemediationStrings.Description: Sync the device to regenerate a report from the approved agent and policy.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 扫描报告校验失败
RemediationStrings.Description: 同步设备，由已批准的 Agent 和策略重新生成扫描报告。

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel scan result is stale
RemediationStrings.Description: Keep the device online and sync Intune.

RemediationStrings.Title: Sentinel 扫描结果已过期
RemediationStrings.Description: 保持设备联网并等待 Intune 修复任务运行。

RemediationStrings.Title: Critical AI Agent risk detected
RemediationStrings.Description: Stop using the affected tool and contact the security team.

RemediationStrings.Title: 发现严重 AI Agent 风险
RemediationStrings.Description: 停止使用相关工具并联系安全团队。

RemediationStrings.Title: High AI Agent risk detected
RemediationStrings.Description: Remove the unapproved Skill or MCP, or request a security exception.

RemediationStrings.Title: 存在被策略阻断的 AI Agent 风险
RemediationStrings.Description: 移除未批准的 Skill/MCP 或联系安全团队完成例外审批。
